- Validate input has at least two elements; compute min_val = min(numbers) and max_val = max(numbers); handle edge case when min_val == max_val (e.g., return zeros or raise a ValueError per chosen behavior).
- Compute range_val = max_val − min_val; for each x in numbers, compute (x − min_val) / range_val to map smallest to 0 and largest to 1.
- Return the list of transformed values, preserving original order and numeric types (floats).
